description_en: Call the CheckClickhouseToRDS operation to verify the connectivity between a community-compatible ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster and an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
description_zh: 调用CheckClickhouseToRDS接口检查云数据库ClickHouse社区兼容版集群与云数据库RDS MySQL的连通性
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse check-clickhouse-to-rds --db-cluster-id cc-2zeyy362b5sbm0000 --ck-user-name user1 --ck-password 123456Aa --rds-id rm-bp13v4bnwlu8j0000 --rds-vpc-id vpc-wz9mm0qka0winfl470000 --rds-user-name user2 --rds-password 123456Rr --rds-vpc-url rm-bp16t9h3999xb0a70000.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckClickhouseToRDS

parameters.help_en: The ID of the community-compatible ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库ClickHouse社区兼容版集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The port number of the ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
parameters.name: clickhouse_port

parameters.help_en: The database account for the ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库ClickHouse的数据库账号
parameters.name: ck_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password for the ApsaraDB for ClickHouse database account
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库ClickHouse的数据库账号密码
parameters.name: ck_password

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance
parameters.name: rds_id

parameters.help_en: The port number of the ApsaraDB RDS instance
parameters.name: rds_port

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance
parameters.name: rds_vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The database account for the ApsaraDB RDS instance
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库RDS的数据库账号
parameters.name: rds_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password for the ApsaraDB RDS database account
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库RDS的数据库账号密码
parameters.name: rds_password

parameters.help_en: The internal endpoint of the ApsaraDB RDS instance
parameters.name: rds_vpc_url

ErrorCode.description_en:
This parameter is returned only if the connection fails (Status is false).

It indicates the reason for the connection failure
ErrorCode.description_zh:
当Status返回为true时，不返回该参数。
当Status返回为false时，表示不能连通的原因

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether a connection can be established. Valid values:

true: A connection can be established.

false: A connection cannot be established
Status.description_zh:
是否能连通，取值说明：

true：能连通。
false：不能连通
